items.summary: Reject the proposed AllThingsMasonic affiliate CTA experiment for this cycle as capacity-gated and financially unproven. The available baseline is 61 Amazon clicks and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21; causal lift and page-level revenue are unknown. Preserve the existing request as a future candidate only after a slot clears, with existing destinations and disclosure behavior unchanged, and require a pre-change baseline, deterministic validation, rollback point, and a 14-day or 100-relevant-impression/click measurement window.

Reject the proposed MarkItDown prototype for immediate execution. The bounded lab evidence supports research only: 8/8 checks passed under MIT, but dependency installation, security review, maintenance review, financial benefit, and production fitness remain unproven. Retain it outside the active queue until capacity clears and a disposable, fleet-owned corpus can be measured against editorial review time and extraction completeness.

Reject the remaining candidate plan's new execution admissions and retain no new CFO proposal. Delivery is already saturated at 10/10 slots, with 54 improvements measuring, 21 failed requests, 7 open repairs, and 108 approved proposals without execution. Preserve the existing capacity-unblocker and overdue repair-or-close work; do not create duplicate finance, site, or telemetry requests.
